entities.name: Istini Ayesh ni Hata Kan
entities.description: A wrestler from Oneah who survived its fall and later taught goblins mindfulness.

entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: Nation Ayesh came from, destroyed by goblins.

entities.name: Fall of Oneah
entities.description: Goblin conquest of Oneah in 4165 AR.

entities.name: Khairt
entities.description: Grand Champion of the school who survived.

entities.name: Captain Raal
entities.description: Orvadian sailor who traveled with Ayesh and later married her.

entities.name: Mirtiin Rebellion
entities.description: Conflict in which Ayesh taught goblins.

entities.name: King Myrrax
entities.description: Mirtiin minotaur king who sought to reform goblins.

events.summary: During the Fall of Oneah, goblins breach Xa-On and Ayesh hides beneath the Roof of Lights.
events.quote: Ayesh fearfully hid herself beneath the Roof of Lights in a concealed grate

events.summary: Ayesh travels with Captain Raal telling stories of Oneah.
events.quote: She traveled with Captain Raal , an Orvadian sailor

events.summary: Raal leaves Ayesh on Stahaan; she becomes involved in the Mirtiin Rebellion.
events.quote: Ayesh soon became involved in the Mirtiin Rebellion

events.summary: Ayesh is captured and freed by Zhanrax alongside Tlik.
events.quote: Ayesh, captured and left to die in a cage, was ultimately freed by the rogue minotaur Zhanrax alongside Tlik.

events.summary: Ayesh reunites with Raal and they marry.
events.quote: She reunited with Captain Raal, and they were eventually married

relations.quote: she became a wrestler under Telina Hata
with her pupil Tlik managing a level of self-control
